$comment: Single definition of every table's fields and every legend vocabulary. build.py validates data/*.json against this file and generates the legends from it.

agent_tool.label: agent tool
agent_tool.help: A coding-agent product or its gateway (OpenCode Zen / Go, Command Code, …)

first_party.label: first-party
first_party.help: The model maker's own API or app

live.label: live
live.help: Answering requests at the last check

listed.label: listed as free (not tested by us)
listed.help: The provider's page lists it as free; we have not made a call

overdue.label: past announced end
overdue.help: Still live after its announced end date; can stop without notice

unavailable.label: listed, not answering
unavailable.help: Shown in the catalogue but not usable at the last check

inferred.label: inferred
inferred.help: Derived from an announced duration or a sibling channel

none.label: none
none.help: No end announced; it can still stop at any time

agent_run.label: agent run
agent_run.help: A real coding-agent task completed and independently verified

catalogue.label: catalogue
catalogue.help: Read the provider's model list, no successful call

listing.label: listing only
listing.help: Read the model's web page, no call

may_train.label: may be logged / used for training

none.label: $0, no account
none.help: Usable without paying or signing up

account.label: $0 with an account
account.help: Free after signing up; no card

invite.label: $0, invitation only
invite.help: Free, but sign-up needs an invitation or an established account elsewhere

subscription.label: paid plan first
subscription.help: A paid subscription must be active before the free models work

topup.label: top-up first
topup.help: A minimum credit purchase is needed before use

api.label: API
api.help: Reachable with an API key from your own tools

own_cli.label: CLI only
own_cli.help: Free models work only inside the vendor's own CLI or app

own_app.label: App only
own_app.help: Free models work only inside the vendor's desktop or web app

no_automation.label: human only
no_automation.help: The terms forbid scripts, bots or autonomous agents

taste.label: A few dozen a day
taste.help: Roughly 100 requests a day or fewer

daily.label: Hundreds a day
daily.help: Hundreds of requests a day, or only a few at once

bulk.label: 10+ at once, all day
bulk.help: Ten or more parallel agent runs worked in our tests
